_note: Tracks how many times each clips/ video has been used as an Instagram Reels background, least-used-first (scripts/pick_clip.py reads/updates this automatically). SEED THIS BEFORE FIRST USE: add one entry per clip filename you drop into clips/, all starting at 0, e.g. {"my_clip_a.mov": 0, "my_clip_b.mov": 0}. pick_clip.py calls min() on these counts directly and will crash on an empty dict, so this file can't stay blank once you're ready to render.
